purpose: Select one finite historical-only Campaign059 mechanism after Campaign058 from frozen definitions and source schemas only, before reading any Campaign059 minute row, market-benchmark value, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: Equal-position sign agreement measures how often a stock joins the broad market direction while discarding return magnitude. It is not determined by linear correlation, beta, residual variance, market-shock magnitude, morning-minus-afternoon correlation, or dispersion exposure.
The historical 09:30 price has terminally invalid placeholder semantics, and reopening a previous-close opening-gap mechanism would violate the frozen historical boundary.
Directional serial dependence, bipower-to-realized variation, return-variance entropy, skewness, and their tail or jump complements are already terminal families.
Those magnitude-sensitive market-exposure mechanisms are already represented by terminal factors and may not be rewindowed, inverted, or rescued.
Counting zero-zero as agreement would confound sparse price updating; weighting by magnitude or conditioning on a regime would create formula and filter searches.
The complete 238-position grid and one fixed minimum of 60 jointly nonzero positions are the sole support rule; no threshold or window sweep is allowed.
Campaign059 computes one direct source statistic and neither loads terminal scores into its formula nor fits weights, thresholds, filters, subsets, or models.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_market_directional_sign_agreement_238m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock that repeatedly joins the contemporaneous broad-market direction across the full continuous session exhibits common-information demand confirmation rather than isolated stock-specific noise, which may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: Across the exact 238 within-half signed log-close return positions, compute the frozen leave-one-out equal-weight market return from return_sum and valid_stock_count. A position is informative only when both the stock return and leave-one-out market return are finite and exactly nonzero. Return the number of equal-sign informative positions divided by the informative-position count.
selected_candidate.accepted_grid: Exactly 120 closes at 09:31-11:30 and 120 closes at 13:01-15:00; form 119 adjacent returns independently inside each half, exclude standalone 09:30 and the lunch transition.
selected_candidate.leave_one_out_rule: At every fixed return position subtract the stock return and its finite-observation count from the frozen market sum and count; require at least 50 other finite peers at every position.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: A position with an exact-zero stock return or exact-zero leave-one-out market return is noninformative and is neither an agreement nor a disagreement.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both complete 238-position return vectors are finite, every position has at least 50 leave-one-out peers, at least 60 positions are jointly nonzero, and the final score is finite in [0,1].

decision.next_action: Challenge the fixed sign-agreement statistic against all 90 required definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first no-return protocol before any Campaign059 source, benchmark, candidate, or comparison value is read.
